name: Semmelweis University
summary: Budapest university founded 1769; 3 long-cycle degrees (medicine, dentistry, pharmacy) and 8 health bachelor's taught in English.

ib.text: No IB-specific rule: entry is Semmelweis's own entrance exam and interview (oral exam for health BSc). Final-year students can apply and upload the IB certificate by August.

dates.label: Application deadline: medicine, dentistry, pharmaceutical sciences
School-leaving certificate upload due if you apply in your final school year

programmes.name: General Medicine
programmes.about: Six-year one-tier medical degree in English (360 credits): two theory years, a pre-clinical year, clinical rotations in years 4-5 and an internship year, ending in state exams.
programmes.overview: The first two years are theory: medical chemistry, biophysics, cell and molecular biology, anatomy, histology, embryology and physiology. Year three moves to pathology, pathophysiology, microbiology and immunology, with hands-on work that includes anatomical and pathological autopsies. In years four and five you rotate through the clinical disciplines in small groups, while ethics and medical psychology run alongside. The final year is an internship across internal medicine, surgery, paediatrics, obstetrics and gynaecology, neurology, psychiatry and family medicine, with a thesis and state exams at the end. Graduates go on to specialist training, doctoral research, or work in hospitals, public health and health administration.
programmes.ib: No IB subject or exemption rule: an online exam in medical biology, medical chemistry, English and biomedical English, then an interview, decide. Apply in your final IB year.
programmes.selectionNote: Own online exam (20 questions each in biology, chemistry, English, biomedical English) plus an interview; your school record and motivation letter count too.

programmes.name: Dentistry
programmes.about: Five-year one-tier dental degree in English (311 credits), preparing you to practise dentistry or continue into specialist or PhD training.
programmes.overview: Basic sciences and general medical knowledge are taught in the departments and clinics of the partner faculties, with dental subjects appearing early and taking up more of the timetable from the third year on. Teaching happens in small-group practicals led by close to sixty dentists, so you build independent clinical skills before graduating. Four summer practices cover the dental laboratory, dental assistance, dento-alveolar work and general dentistry. A thesis is part of the degree. Graduates can start practising dentistry or move into specialist or PhD training.
programmes.ib: No IB subject or exemption rule: an online exam in medical biology, medical chemistry, English and biomedical English, then an interview, decide. Apply in your final IB year.
programmes.selectionNote: Own online exam (20 questions each in biology, chemistry, English, biomedical English) plus an interview; your school record and motivation letter count too.

programmes.name: Pharmaceutical Sciences
programmes.about: Five-year one-tier pharmacy degree in English (307 credits) on a broad science base, with routes into pharmacy, the pharmaceutical industry, research and related sciences.
programmes.overview: The first two years rest on chemistry, biology, mathematics and physics, taught through both lectures and laboratory classes. Pharmacy-specific subjects arrive in years two and three, with a high share of practical training and several internships. Work on the diploma thesis begins in the fourth year, and the degree ends with a compulsory practice period, thesis submission and a final exam. Teaching draws on a large clinical base for bedside pharmacy training. Graduates work in pharmaceutical research, industry, regulatory authorities and the pharmaceutical trade across the EU, and the science grounding also opens related fields such as chemistry, bioengineering and biology.
programmes.ib: No IB subject or exemption rule: an online exam in biology, chemistry, English and biomedical English, then an interview, decide. Apply in your final IB year.
programmes.selectionNote: Own online exam (20 questions each in biology, chemistry, English, biomedical English) plus an interview; your school record and motivation letter count too.

programmes.name: Nursing
programmes.about: Four-year nursing degree in English (240 credits) preparing you to deliver prescribed nursing care to patients of any age in primary, hospital and hospice settings.
programmes.overview: The first year is built on health-science basics such as anatomy, physiology and pathophysiology, and public health and epidemiology, followed by nursing theory and practice. You learn in small groups with a mentor, and clinical practice under tutor supervision runs through the degree. The fourth year is mostly field placements and the thesis. You can focus on areas such as internal medicine, surgery, obstetrics-gynaecology, intensive therapy, paediatrics, neurology, psychiatry, primary care and oncology. Graduates work in primary care, hospital wards, nursing homes and hospices, or continue to a master's.
programmes.selectionNote: Oral entrance exam online (Zoom) on the field of study; your school record and documents count too. No IB subject is required.

programmes.name: Midwifery
programmes.about: Four-year midwifery degree in English (240 credits): care in pregnancy, birth and the postpartum period, working with other health professionals.
programmes.overview: Year one covers health-science foundations: anatomy, physiology and pathophysiology, public health and epidemiology. Later years bring midwifery subjects including obstetrics-gynaecology, neonatal and paediatric medicine and nursing, perioperative care, the psychology of supportive connection and ethics in midwifery. Small classes, a mentor system and a high-fidelity birthing simulator prepare you for supervised clinical placements, and the fourth year is mainly field practice and the thesis. Graduates work in delivery rooms, prenatal and postpartum care, outpatient departments, lactation consulting and family planning, or go on to a master's.
programmes.selectionNote: Oral entrance exam online (Zoom) on the field of study; your school record and documents count too. No IB subject is required.

programmes.name: Dietetics
programmes.about: Four-year dietetics degree in English (240 credits): evidence-based nutrition, diet therapy for disease, counselling and prevention.
programmes.overview: After a first year of health-science basics, you study food science, meal preparation technology, nutrition science, public health nutrition, clinical dietetics, catering management and food hygiene. Small-group teaching with a mentor includes cooking practice in teaching kitchens, and you train in clinics and food-production plants under tutor supervision. The fourth year is given to field placements and a thesis that you defend before graduating. Graduates work as nutrition experts in hospitals and care institutions, as nutrition advisers, or in catering, fitness and wellness and health promotion, and can continue to a master's.
programmes.selectionNote: Oral entrance exam online (Zoom) on the field of study; your school record and documents count too. No IB subject is required.

programmes.name: Physiotherapy
programmes.about: Four-year physiotherapy degree in English (240 credits): therapeutic exercise, manual techniques and rehabilitation for musculoskeletal and other disorders.
programmes.overview: The first year covers health-science basics including anatomy, physiology, pathophysiology, oncology and public health. You then study the functional analysis of the musculoskeletal system, electrotherapy, cardiorespiratory and internal-medicine physiotherapy, orthopaedic and neurological work, and physiotherapy for specific age groups including children. Small classes, a mentor system and well-equipped skill labs support the practical side, with clinical placements throughout and extended fieldwork and a thesis in year four. Graduates work in hospitals, clinics, rehabilitation centres, sports medicine, home care and wellness, or progress to the physiotherapy master's.
programmes.selectionNote: Oral entrance exam online (Zoom) on the field of study; your school record and documents count too. No IB subject is required.

programmes.name: Medical Diagnostic Analysis (Optometry)
programmes.about: Four-year degree in English (240 credits) with an optometry specialisation: eye examination, correction of refractive errors and prescribing glasses and contact lenses.
programmes.overview: After a first year of anatomy, physiology and other health-science basics, optometry content takes over: ocular anatomy, ophthalmic pathology and optics, contact lenses, clinical ophthalmology, binocular vision, ophthalmic technology and paediatric ophthalmology. Teaching is in small groups with a mentor, and clinical practice builds up to field placements and a thesis in the fourth year. The diploma records the optometry specialisation. Graduates work in optical shops, outpatient eye clinics and hospitals, diagnostic laboratories and optical-product management, and can continue to a master's.
programmes.selectionNote: Oral entrance exam online (Zoom) on the field of study; your school record and documents count too. No IB subject is required.

programmes.name: Public Health Supervisor
programmes.about: Four-year public health degree in English (240 credits): disease prevention, risk investigation and health surveillance of the population.
programmes.overview: You begin with anatomy, physiology, pathophysiology and microbiology, then move into applied chemistry, toxicology, public health engineering, environmental health, food hygiene and safety, epidemiology and prevention of communicable diseases, occupational health, chemical safety and radiation health. Training in clinics and public health institutions is practice-oriented and supervised by tutors, and the fourth year is field practice and a thesis defended at the end. Graduates work in regional public health administration, hospital hygiene, industrial and agricultural inspection, multinational companies, health insurance, occupational health and health promotion, or continue to a master's.
programmes.selectionNote: Oral entrance exam online (Zoom) on the field of study; your school record and documents count too. No IB subject is required.

programmes.name: Health Care Management with Health Tourism Specialisation
programmes.about: Three-and-a-half-year degree in English (210 credits) on organising health promotion and health-tourism services and EU-funded tourism development projects.
programmes.overview: Health-science foundations such as anatomy, physiology and preventive medicine sit beside leisure and tourism studies, health tourism products and medical tourism. Later modules cover health destination development, experience and service design, sales and marketing in health tourism, spa management and event management, along with quality management, project management and online communication. Small-group teaching with mentor support leads to a final semester of field practice and the thesis. Graduates work with health service providers, tour operators, health resorts, sanatoria, private healthcare providers, spas and thermal baths.
programmes.selectionNote: Oral entrance exam online (Zoom) on the field of study; your school record and documents count too. No IB subject is required.

programmes.name: Conductive Education
programmes.about: Four-year degree in English (240 credits) from the András Pető Faculty: the Pető method for children and adults with motor disabilities, plus qualification to teach in nursery and primary school.
programmes.overview: The degree combines social, medical and pedagogical sciences: pedagogy, psychology, IT, a foreign language and conductive pedagogy in year one, then neurology, communication and medical biology, with legal and ethical aspects and rehabilitation in the last year. Practice classes start in the first week, and in the final year nearly every second class is practice with real children, using the faculty's own practice areas. In the second year you choose nursery school education, primary school education or pedagogical rehabilitation. Graduates work as conductor teachers in multi-professional education, rehabilitation or health settings, including adult rehabilitation for conditions such as Parkinson's disease.
programmes.ib: An aptitude exam is required, and the programme starts only if at least 10 students enrol.
programmes.selectionNote: Aptitude exam; 2026 dates shown (apply 1 Feb-1 Aug 2026), 2027 not yet published. Runs only with at least 10 enrolled students.

notes: The English programmes are for applicants outside the Hungarian school-leaving system; applying through Felvi for Hungarian-language medicine, dentistry or pharmacy makes you ineligible for the English ones.
One tuition price is published per programme, with no separate EU rate; the admission procedure fee is USD 400 (2026/27 rules).
Medicine, dentistry and pharmacy exams run online from early spring, each applicant gets two attempts, and you register for an exam date in SEMAPHOR after you apply.
